title: Turnkey renovation in Kyiv — from $550/m² | CAS Development
description: Turnkey renovation of apartments, houses and offices in Kyiv: design, estimate, all works, materials and furniture. From $550/m², offices from $350/m².
price: apartments and houses from $550 / m² · offices from $350 / m²
lead: For us “turnkey” means the full cycle: design project, estimate, all construction and finishing works, purchasing of materials, furniture and final cleaning. You walk into a finished space.
about: When design, works and supply are run by one company, there is no downtime between contractors and no arguments about who is to blame. We prepare the estimate before the start and keep to it: if CAS does the renovation, the total stays within ±5%.
Since 2016 we have completed more than 150 projects — apartments, private houses, offices, restaurants and salons. Furniture and materials come directly from China, so furnishing costs less.
steps: Phone consultation is free; site measurement and inspection are paid and priced individually.
Design, drawings and a detailed estimate.
Price, timeline and payment stages fixed.
Our own crew, regular reports, quality control at every stage.
Furniture, lighting, cleaning — you move in or start working.
faq: Design project, estimate, demolition, rough and finishing works, electrics, plumbing, purchasing of materials, furniture, cleaning and handover.

Apartments and houses from $550 per m², offices from $350 per m². The price from $550/m² covers works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are priced separately in the estimate. If CAS does the renovation, the final amount stays within ±5% of the approved estimate.
